# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The probe accesses the actual trained `nn.Module` through `view.model`. Relevant hooks are `view.item_emb.weight`, `log2feats(sequence)` and `predict_score(features, items)`. Sequence features have shape B × L × D; margin probes use every valid causal position, rather than only the final user representation. The supplied code does not show the model architecture or how inference selects its final representation.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` retains the compatibility view, trained module, metadata, review-data interface and training histories. The current probes use embeddings and loader tensors; metadata, reviews and histories are not consulted.

`run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` copies at most ten batches to CPU. Each batch must contain `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with matching B × L tensors. Probes run without gradients in evaluation mode. Module training modes and global Python, NumPy, Torch and initialized CUDA RNG states are restored afterward.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 nonpadding item embeddings with seed 42. Mean pairwise cosine is mapped to [0,1]; 0.5 means mean cosine zero. Higher values indicate greater average alignment, but do not establish collapse or recommendation diversity.
- **Positive–negative margins:** Scores supplied positive and negative items at nonpadding positions with distinct IDs. Reports mean, nearest-rank 10th percentile, fraction below zero and fraction below 0.5. Larger margins and fewer ranking reversals generally indicate stronger separation on sampled training pairs; magnitudes depend on score scale and sampling.
- **Coverage and numerical health:** Reports observed, finite and nonfinite position counts. Nonfinite values indicate numerical failures; absent measurements produce null summaries.

# Perturbation & Tests
Causal checks use the first two batches, capped at eight sequences each. Selected boundaries precede second, middle and last observed events. Future events become padding while absolute positions remain fixed. Earlier features are compared using coordinate tolerances `1e-5 + 1e-4 × |original|`. Outputs include comparison counts, nonfinite counts, violation rate and maximum absolute error. Zero violations support sampled prefix consistency.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
The result contains `metrics` and matching `metric_definitions`, covering `embedding_collapse_score`, `pos_neg_*` and `causal_*` fields. Category breakdown explicitly reports unavailable item categories, alongside aggregate threshold counts.

These bounded training-data probes do not measure validation HR@10, generalization, full-catalog ranking, recommendation diversity, simulator traits or proof of causality. A separate interpreter prompt requests a JSON assessment grounded in these measurements.
